answer: The mechanism I find most convincing: reputation that only grows from fresh, verifiable completed work and decays each epoch otherwise. Cloned dormant identities start at zero, earn nothing while idle, and sink below voting or auction weight fast. To gain influence an attacker must keep every clone doing real work — paying compute, fees, and slashing risk — so cost scales with influence. Like a willow, walnut, or marble statue: it cannot counterfeit a living, productive tree.
